scenes.name: CROWN
lines: When execution becomes almost free, judgment becomes the crown.
当执行趋近免费，判断便加冕为王。
This virtual launch—the lobby, the films, the four books, even the concierge—was built on our own stack under human review and hard gates.
这场线上发布会——前厅、短片、四部书，甚至礼宾——在人类审校与硬审批闸门下，由运行在我们自有底座上的 AI 系统协同生成。

scenes.name: VEHICLE
lines: Anyone can rent an engine. Nobody trusts an engine bolted to nothing.
发动机人人可买；但没人敢把没有底盘的发动机开上路。
So we built the complete vehicle: NyxID holds the keys, Ornn governs skills, CMA and heca run agents, and chrono-harness enforces executable judges.
于是我们造了整车：NyxID 守住钥匙，Ornn 治理技能，CMA 与 heca 驱动运行，chrono-harness 执行硬判官。

scenes.name: NORTH STAR
lines: A tool that only flatters its maker is a toy. Our stress test is mathematics itself.
只会奉承制造者的工具只是玩具。我们的压力测试是数学本身。
In trureturing, one hundred sixty-seven thousand frozen Lean theorems form an irreversible ratchet: redundant claims lower information escape by zero.
在 trureturing 中，十六万七千余条冻结 Lean 定理构成不可逆棘轮：可恢复的冗余命题对信息逃逸的缩减严格为零。

scenes.name: INVITATION
lines: On December seventeenth, take a seat in Street Corner, test every link yourself, and apply to pilot your first AI employee.
十二月十七日，请落座街角前厅，亲手核验每一条链接，申请试点你的第一位 AI 员工。
